decided_by: user (paper completion, 11 Nov 2026; Update 10 A pooling approved 10 Nov), generated
policy: Pool a listed cell across workspace commits only if every algorithm-relevant receipt is byte-identical (effective configuration, binaries, runtime assets, algorithm source tree, parameters, environment, container, machine). Only the workspace commit and the scripts/configs tree may differ; a listed diagnostic parameter may be absent in older runs at its default. Checked automatically by scripts/campaign/build_repair_inventory.py (pooled_cohort); a mismatch keeps separate groups.

harness_python.question: Pool repetitions whose only receipt difference (besides the workspace) is the Python version of the harness that launched the estimator (3.10.20 on 7-8 Oct, 3.13.5 in the 18 Oct batch, 3.10.12 in the AirSLAM LC completion)?

stage_watchdog.question: Pool repetitions whose recorded stage watchdog differs (AirSLAM: 43200 s for run40101 and the 7 Oct VO-LC r1 attempts, 7200 s for the LC completion runs), given that no run reached it? Update 10 A declared a 10800 s overall limit and no native-stage watchdog (search-gates.md).
